Files.Name: base
Files.Description: What every machine of the owner carries
Files.Text:
machinefile: station.machinefile/v1
name: base
description: What every machine of the owner carries
apps: [jq]

Files.Name: base-debian
Files.Description: A Debian 13 machine with Spwn's plumbing and nothing else
Files.Text:
machinefile: station.machinefile/v1
name: base-debian
description: A Debian 13 machine with Spwn's plumbing and nothing else
machine:
    kind: workspace
    system: { os: debian, version: '13', arch: arm64 }
vm:
    lifetime: ephemeral
    resources: { cpus: 4, memory: 8G, disk: 20G }
    network: nat
    image:
        from: 'ghcr.io/cirruslabs/debian@sha256:74f0de37c757af07910e18fec88c80bcf828259ff01a0b0e1daa596b3281c7cb'

Files.Name: base-macos
Files.Description: A macOS workspace with Homebrew, git and zsh

Files.Name: base-ubuntu
Files.Description: A Linux workspace with the runtime manager, git, zsh, Docker and headless Chromium's libraries

Files.Name: macbook-pro
Files.Text:
machinefile: station.machinefile/v1
name: macbook-pro
description: The owner's Mac
machine: { kind: computer, system: { os: macos } }
extends: [base]
apps: [lazygit, bat]
